events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: This month marks 30 years since the shooting of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this month, the world of music was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur. We're looking back at the enduring legacy of a true hip-hop legend.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Mark the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix today. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released 57 years ago on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road's 57th
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous of all time, but what's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy 75th Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy 54th Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic 'Imagine' album was released 55 years ago, on September 9, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates as strongly today as it did then.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: This month marks 25 years since Apple unveiled its groundbreaking first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: 25 Years of iPod
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? This month marks 25 years since Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film's premiere.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment or tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's 86th
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring impact of John Lennon, a true musical visionary.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy 87th John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his work is simply brilliant.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible stage presence and unparalleled vocal talent continue to captivate.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. Still a masterpiece.
